preconditions.classification_rule: trigger+action => rule; trigger-only with an explicit descriptive_or_negated_context_marker => no_rule; other trigger-only => ambiguous; no trigger => no_rule

semantic_zero_match_certificate.pass_rule: every source block appears exactly once; all classifications are no_rule; block hashes, locators, source snapshot/hash and coverage digest match; analyzer contract is approved and result digest is recomputed
semantic_zero_match_certificate.negative_claim_rule: the certificate only states that the approved analyzer found no documented rule in the scanned source; it never states that the system has no exception

verification_algorithm: recompute the normalized scan for every current source Block using SND-RULE-002
verify source snapshot/hash, analyzer contract hash, block list, block hash, locator, coverage digest and result digest
compare every recomputed Block classification and evidence digest with the certificate exactly once
emit a verifier receipt with the recomputed certificate digest and comparison digest
zero_match_certificate_verifier.mismatch_policy: any mismatch is UNKNOWN/Audit-only/not_released; it cannot be repaired by reusing the producer certificate

negative_cases.input: producer certificate has one altered Block classification
producer certificate has a stale source hash but a closed result digest
producer certificate is reused without an independent verifier receipt

receipt_contract.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 recursive Unicode-key-sorted JSON, no spaces, arrays preserve order, one trailing LF, canonical_sha256 excludes itself
bindings: current source snapshot and content hash
producer certificate ref and actual SHA-256
same attempt identity at SND Reader promotion, M401 finalize and M402 release predicate
receipt_contract.promotion_rule: only a passed attempt with exact source/certificate/material bindings may update promotion_path; public_projection_path is a sanitized projection of that promoted receipt; unknown/blocked attempts remain append-only and cannot be consumed as Reader evidence

reader_slots.source_scope: 在 SND-RULE-002 的扫描范围内，当前资料未记录可验证的异常规则。
reader_slots.scan_coverage: 按 SND-RULE-002 扫描本资料的全部内容、表格、代码/配置和链接；逐 Block 覆盖已闭合。
reader_slots.zero_match_result: 在该扫描范围内未找到明确异常规则，也未发现含糊匹配。
reader_slots.interpretation_boundary: 这是资料记录状态，不是系统行为结论；不能据此证明系统不存在异常。
reader_slots.verification_next_step: 如需诊断具体异常，请补充独立的触发条件、现象、检查步骤和处理动作来源。
